title: Two Sum
statement: Given an integer array and a target, return the indexes of two values whose sum equals the target. Assume exactly one valid answer exists and the same element cannot be used twice.

editor_note.idea: Scan once and store each number's index after checking whether its complement has appeared.
editor_note.data_structure_reason: A hash map turns the complement lookup into average O(1) time.
editor_note.edge_cases: Store the current value after the lookup so the same element is not matched with itself.
editor_note.pitfalls: If duplicates exist, update order matters.
